name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Weighted)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, standing on one foot at a step's edge.
Rise as high as possible on the ball of your foot.
Pause at the top for a full second.
Lower slowly past parallel for a deep stretch. Unilateral calf strength.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Weighted) is an intermediate core exercise targeting the calves, performed with dumbbells. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
